title: FIXIT Forum: Sewing Circle
description: Do you have holes in your socks, like any true punk? how about a ripped out pocket? Today we're dedicating space to fixing all things sewing and sewing machine-related. Bring your sewables, or your expertise. Help and be helped!

title: FDN 11010: Intro to Hacking
description: Welcome, students, to MCAD's underground course on HACKING. Today we'll be examining topical content that you might suddenly find yourself concerned with, like 'how to break AI models,' 'how to move through through the web without leaving a trace,' and an open session about what YOU want your computer to be ABLE TO DO.

title: DORKING FOR DORKS
description: Learn to use search engines to the fullest extent of their power. Find hidden sites and vulnerable interfaces, bypass firewalls and paywalls, sort out the useless from the useful. Learn to DORK!. [WARNING: you will never find a more useful tool for gathering scholarly articles, doing research effectively, or finding valuable information for free.]
